content: We need to find a template that when applied retrosynthetically to the given molecule (Nc1ccc(cc1)[N+](=O)[O-]) reproduces the SNAr reaction: nucleophile (amine) replaces a halide on aromatic ring, with nitro activation. The product SMILES is an aniline with nitro group? Actually given SMILES: Nc1ccc(cc1)[N+](=O)[O-] is p-aminonitrobenzene? Wait structure: N attached to aromatic carbon (aniline) and nitro group para? The SMILES: N c1 c c c (c c1) [N+](=O)[O-]. So aniline with nitro group at para? The nucleophile is amine, leaving group halide. So the precursor would be a nitrohalobenzene (e.g., p-fluoronitrobenzene) plus amine (maybe ammonia). But the retrosynthetic step: break C-N bond (amine) and form C-halide bond. So we need template for SNAr (aryl halide + amine -> aryl amine). The template ID we need to retrieve. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria but functional_groups_formed should be "primary amines" maybe? The product has primary amine functional group. The functional group formed is "primary amines". The list includes "primary amines". So use that. Also broken functional group is "halide". So functional_groups_broken: ["halide"]; functional_groups_formed: ["primary amines"]; bonds broken/formed: aromatic C-C? Actually C-N bond formed, C-halide broken. Both are aromatic C-X bonds (6-6). So bonds_broken: ["6-6"]; bonds_formed: ["6-6"]; Let's search.
